messages:
marta (People Ops): quick Q from a manager: external candidate starts same week an internal promo is planned. need evidence cutoff, retro timing, and equity alignment.

josh (Eng Manager): timeline is messy. if we onboard as a hire vs an internal transfer, does payroll treat it differently?

marta (People Ops): yes. transfer = comp_change flow. external new hire = offer/grant from hiring flow. both need manager sign-off + evidence to hit an effective date.

sana (Recruiter): candidate accepted 2026-04-12, start 2026-05-03; manager wants promo effective 2026-05-01. can we sync?

ethan (Payroll): to hit May 1 in May payroll, submit comp_change_form + evidence by 2026-05-10 23:59 PT. miss cutoff -> retro next payroll (usually one-payroll delay).

marta (People Ops): equity: grant created after comp approval. grants post to equity system in ~2-3 business days; attach grant rationale in evidence.

alex (Hiring Manager): if offer already has equity but we also do a promo day 1, will they get two grants?

marta (People Ops): don't duplicate. decide in offer whether equity covers target comp. if separate grant needed, mark grant_needed and attach rationale.

josh (Eng Manager): checklist pls?

marta (People Ops): checklist: 1) manager sign-off, 2) evidence doc, 3) comp_change_form or offer, 4) mark grant_needed if applicable, 5) submit by cutoff. exceptions -> payroll emergency ticket.
